change_summary: Make T1.0.1 the default for in-scope MPI Buddhist document translation while preserving explicit strategy overrides; require the separately versioned T1 installer readiness gate; require auditable authoritative-web verification when internal terminology is missing, conflicting, or substantively uncertain; unresolved core items require human judgment.

default_routing.scope: MPI Chinese-to-English Buddhist books, articles, and documents
default_routing.condition: the user requests translation without naming another strategy

adoption_evidence.decision: The user reported that human adjudication selected C+ as the best version and requested it be frozen as production strategy T1.
adoption_evidence.scope: workflow baseline selection; not blanket approval of future translations

network_terminology_policy.trigger: internal no-result, credible source conflict, or substantive uncertainty
network_terminology_policy.privacy: query the smallest public expression; explicit consent is required before transmitting private passage context
network_terminology_policy.unresolved_core_term: human_choice or blocked; never silently freeze
network_terminology_policy.missing_receipt: blocks affected term freeze and T1 completion
